messages.subject: using address= in dataProcessPlots
parts:
Hi:

I am new to MSstats and I am beginning to feel like a real ninny.

I am playing with the examples from the ABRF meeting.

when I add xyz as an "address"

dataProcessPlots(data=quantData,type="ProfilePlot",address="xyz")
the file gets made in the working directory with the xyz prefix but is not put into the subdirectory xyz below the working directory like the man page says.

What am I doing wrong? Am I reading the man page incorrectly.

thanks in advance for your help.

Mark Shifman

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: using address= in dataProcessPlots
parts:
Dea Mark,

If you assign the name of subdirectory,xyz, you can use address="xyz/" (add slash to distinguish that this is the folder name). Then 'ProfilePlot.pdf' file will be generated in 'xyz' folder under the working directory.

In another example, if you want to add 'abc' prefix in the file name, and want to save it in WorkingDirectory/xyz folder, you can use address="xyz/abc". Then 'abc_ProfilePlot.pdf' will be saved in WorkingDirectlry/xyz folder.

I hope it will be helpful.
Thanks,

Meena
